title: Maryland Resident Experience Survey closed — 212 responses ready
description: The survey closed overnight with 212 responses. A data-quality sweep has already run against the set and flagged five classes of fix — incompletes, duplicates, speeders, junk open-text and stray ZIP formatting — for your review before any insight is drawn.
data_note: Illustrative. No figure here describes real Maryland program data — response counts, satisfaction scores and open-text themes are fabricated for demonstration.

confidence.rationale: Response counts reconcile between the survey platform's own submission log and the contact registry's delivery receipts. Held below 100 because the data-quality sweep is a recommendation, not an applied change — the valid-response denominator moves depending on which fixes you accept.

action: Review the proposed data-quality fixes, then pull satisfaction and open-text themes from the cleaned set.

title: Permit Renewal Feedback draft ships tomorrow, still unfinished
description: The Permit Renewal Feedback survey is scheduled to go out tomorrow and eight of its nine questions can be answered as they stand. One thing blocks the send: Q7 has no answer options, so residents cannot answer it. Distribution and delivery are still to be confirmed, and Q5 is flagged for a plain-language rewrite — neither of those stops the survey going out.
data_note: Illustrative. The survey, its questions and its distribution lists are fabricated for demonstration and do not describe a real Maryland instrument.

confidence.rationale: The blocker is read directly from the draft's own validation state rather than inferred — a question with no answer options cannot be answered. Held below 100 because the send schedule is author-set and can move, so 'ships tomorrow' is a stated intent rather than a committed job.

action: Set answer options for Q7, then confirm distribution and send it for approval.
